limitations: Repeated regression corpus, not a blind test; no new paired material
Automatic pairing and selected reference tracks do not prove identical editions
Initial unrecognized unit retains the documented quarter-note assumption
Later numeric marks with unconfirmed units or positions block export
Other tempo units, inside-bar changes, ramps and pure-text rit/accel are not supported
Techniques, repeats, grace placement, audio rendering and device playback remain incomplete
